Body.Content:
Azure Storage includes locally redundant storage, geo-redundant storage, and read-access geo-redundant storage. Locally redundant storage has multiple replicas in a region, and geo-redundant storage has multiple copies replicated across two regions. Now we're adding zone-redundant storage, which has multiple copies replicated across two to three facilities.

For more information, visit the Storage webpage. For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Storage pricing details webpage.
